align_sequences_to_hmm_profile: create a Hmmalign wrapper to align a list of raw sequences to an HMM profile and return A3M output
align_a3m_sequences_to_profile: build a Hmmalign wrapper to align A3M formatted sequences to an HMM profile with optional extra flags
align_sequences_to_profile_with_gap_remo: create a Hmmalign wrapper to align A3M sequences to a profile after stripping gaps and uppercasing insertions
convert_sequences_to_a3m_format: build a function that converts a list of sequence strings into A3M format with numbered headers
initialize_hmmalign_wrapper: create a Hmmalign instance by providing the path to the hmmalign binary and validating it exists
